| [Governance cadence](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Prepares and follows up the department's governance routines: a COP or other round (agenda, plant status with one traffic light, numbered call for action, follow-up), finds past decisions and decks (ODEC is historical), drafts regional and plant roadmap rows, sorts a request into small change, project or governance board, plans and reviews a use-case sprint, and runs a toolbox training offer. Use when a round or status report is due, a call for action must be written, a roadmap is drafted or refreshed, a request must go to a ticket or a project, a sprint is planned or reviewed, or a training offer needs a needs list. Method only: no dates, counts or plant statuses; the OD lead approves and sends. Not for the monthly retro (dept-retro), risk readings (dept-risk) or who decides (dept-decision-rights). |
